messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: High error rate (5xx) observed for requests routed to eu-west2. Severity: P2. Auto-escalating to #incidents and paging oncall.

maya (oncall): I'm on it, joining. Seeing spike ~30% 5xx across eu-west2 edge nodes starting ~5m ago. Latency steering metrics show traffic weight for eu -> apac flip on some prefixes.

raj-net: Confirmed — a recent steering threshold change (deploy at 05:10 UTC) lowered the latency delta window; noise from a transient probe caused policy to shift heavy weight to apac for eu customer prefixes.

elena-sre: Impacting sync-heavy customers — increased request latency and some downstream timeouts (502 / malformed response).

maya (oncall): Action plan: 1) revert steering threshold change 2) apply emergency pin to route eu customer prefixes to eu-west2 3) ask support to contact top impacted customers.

raj-net: Rolling back threshold now. Command: `infractl steer rollback --policy latency-window-agg --to-revision v1.16 --reason "auto-flip causing cross-region misroute"`

ops-bot: rollback started by raj-net at 1823456945.

elena-sre: Applying emergency pin override for affected prefixes: `route-ctl override set --prefix eu-cust-01 --region eu-west2 --ttl 30s --note "incident 1823456789 emergency pin"`

maya (oncall): Running quick health checks: `curl -sS -D - https://api.eu.example.com/health` against a few endpoints. Seeing 200s returning for pinned endpoints, but global load balancer still serving some stale DNS entries.

maya (oncall): We should force edge DNS cache invalidation for the affected PoPs. raj-net can you run the flush?

raj-net: Kicking off DNS flush job: `edgectl dns flush --region eu-west2 --prefixes eu-cust-*` — job id dfs-1823. Also bumping negative cache TTL to 10s for quick recovery.

support-liaison: Support note: customers showing errors: acme-corp (high-volume API), finlytics (batch ingest), and several dev sandbox orgs. Drafting outreach now. Any ETA on full recovery?

maya (oncall): If rollback + pin + DNS flush complete and no further flips, we should see error rates fall within ~3-7m. Monitoring dashboards: latency-steer-weight metric returning to expected range.

ops-bot: DNS flush job dfs-1823 completed at 1823457030.

raj-net: Rollback acknowledged by control plane at 1823456992. Steering weights stabilized ~40s after.

maya (oncall): Observability - 5xx rate down from 30% -> ~2.5% and trending down. No new flips in last 3m. Marking mitigation in progress.

elena-sre: Post-mortem note: The deploy introduced a too-sensitive hysteresis parameter for latency steering. We'll create a canary gating for threshold changes and add an automatic cooldown to prevent immediate flips from transient probe noise.

support-liaison: Outreach sent to affected customers at 05:35 UTC with short explanation and apology + status updates promise.

maya (oncall): Oncall handoff: I'm staying on till stabilization for 30m, then will pass to afternoon oncall. If error rate < 1% for 30m, we'll resolve incident.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Mitigated — error rate returned to baseline, rollback + pin + DNS flush completed. Follow-up: create postmortem ticket and schedule remediation.

maya (oncall): Posting brief runbook steps for follow-up: 1) revert steering threshold change permanently until gated rollout 2) add canary/gradual ramp for latency policy 3) tune cooldown to 5m min 4) validate cross-region probe noise handling 5) update customer impact list and close support threads.

elena-sre: I'll own the postmortem writeup and assign action items.

support-liaison: Logging customer impact for billing & SLA review.

maya (oncall): Thanks team. Closing live thread once postmortem created. :white_check_mark:
